Re: Connecting in my new capacity!
[contact omitted] Cara Thanassi Tuesday, July 26, 2022 at 9:13:33 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Neema Guliani
Cc: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Nick Pickles, [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh,
[opaque block] [contact omitted], [contact omitted] Adam Siegel, [contact omitted] Michael Camilleri, [contact omitted]
Emma Buckhout
Hi Neema,
It's a pleasure to be connected with you and your colleagues. At the most recent Summit of the Americas, Administrator
Power launched the Voices Initiative. The Initiative is focused on protecting, defending, and promoting civic space in
Central America, with a focus on Promoting Digital Democracy and Countering Digital Authoritarianism; Promoting
Freedom of Expression and Strengthening Independent Media; and Countering Criminalization and Providing Protection.
For the purpose of this initial conversation, we'd like to discuss these issues in the context of El Salvador, Guatemala and
Honduras and the role that Twitter does play and can play in the focus areas identified. Examples of some concrete
1) How does Twitter prepare for and practically address misinformation, disinformation and online threats and harassment
in northern Central America, including in the run up to and during elections (recent elections in Honduras and upcoming
elections in Guatemala) or efforts that might particularly target women candidates or minority populations, for example?
2) How does Twitter relate to/work with state media outlets, such as in El Salvador, where independent media is
increasingly under threat
3) Does/how does Twitter work internally, with civil society organizations and others to fact check and or respond to
misinformation/disinformation/and harassment and what are the processes/timelines for content to be taken down or
persons to be taken off?
4) What is the best way for USAID missions and our partners in the country to learn more about these processes,
increase their capacity to engage in monitoring and oversight, and work with Twitter to address these issues?
I welcome additional input from my colleagues but this may be an overly ambitious agenda for an initial 50 minute call!
Best regards,
Cara
On Tue, Jul 26, 2022 at 5:26 PM Neema Guliani < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Vera -
In terms of the northern triangle call, are there particular topics that you want to focus on (l just want to make sure we
have the right people on the call).
Unfortunately, 5-5:30EST Wed doesn't work. Would Thurs between 3-4 EST or Mon between 10-1 EST work on your
end?
Best,
Neema
On Tue, Jul 26, 2022 at 5:23 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Team Twitter,
I would like to propose that we hold a specific call with our folks on Northern Triangle this week, and have a broader
call with myself, Johnny Walsh, and Adam Siegel on broader potential collaboration.
For the northern triangle discussion, the team proposes this Wednesday, 5 to 550. Is that doable?
thanks so much, Vera
On Mon, Jul 25, 2022 at 3:44 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi All,

I'll get back to you shortly on times, but I actually would love to schedule 2 meetings with you: 1) a general
conversion, perhaps wednesday or thursday of this week, and separately, a targeted conversation that the team
asked me to set up on the Northern Triangle / Central America.
Can we do 2 separate 30 min calls?
thanks so much, Vera
On Mon, Jul 25, 2022 at 9:35 AM Neema Guliani < [contact omitted]> wrote:
It would be great to connect. Would sometime Tues 9-11 EST, Wed 4-6 EST, or Thurs 1:30-3 EST work on your
end? If not, what times work the following week?
On Fri, Jul 22, 2022 at 5:27 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hl Team Twitter,
Circling back to see if we can get a meeting between USAID and Twitter on the books?
cheers, vera
On Fri, Jul 8, 2022 at 8:46 AM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
And forgot to copy Johnny! Here he is.
On Thu, Jul 7, 2022 at 9:37 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Ok great. Hi Team Twitter -
As a former Tweep, and now in my new role in the admin and at USAID, I'd love to connect on engaging
with Twitter in a number of areas, and see how you all are supporting emerging markets, especially where
USAID operates in.
Also copying my partner in crime and boss, Johnny Walsh to see if we can all find a time to connect
virtually.
Cheers, Vera
On Thu, Jul 7, 2022 at 3:04 PM Nick Pickles < [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey Vera,
Congrats on the new role! Our US team leads our work with US agencies, even where their work is
global, so copying in Neema and LC to assist.
Speak soon,
Nick
On Thu, 7 Jul 2022 at 07:40, Vera Zakem < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey Nick!!
How are you?
So I would love to connect in my new capacity as | joined the admin and USAID to lead democracy /
tech / and info related efforts across agency.
Copying my email address! Maybe I can sync up with you and Sineade? USAID is global, so nothing
on US domestic policy.
Cheers, Vera
-
Nick Pickles
Head of Public Policy Strategy, Development and Partnerships
Follow me [contact omitted]

Vera Zakem
Senior Technology and Policy Advisor
USAID
